## Features

- **Remote management:** use `up login` and `up tui --remote` to manage monitors, mutes, SMTP servers and alert channels through an authenticated API.
- **Scripted login:** provide an access token with `--token-stdin`.
- **Docker images:** deploy with Docker Compose using prebuilt GHCR images for Linux amd64 and arm64.
- **Environment configuration:** configure the API, remote mode and result retention through environment variables.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/heohlee/up/compare/v0.5.0...v0.6.0

[Documentation](https://github.com/heohlee/up/blob/v0.6.0/README.md)
